title: Campus Hero Defense
description: Command a squad of student superheroes in a real-time campus defense. Rescue classmates, secure classrooms, level up heroes, chain combos into a Spirit Surge and beat eight invasion waves and the Mecha-Mascot. Sign the local Hall of Fame. Plays on desktop and mobile landscape.

defaultCaptions.x: Grimsby Prep invaded Maplecrest High. Rally your student superheroes and save the school in Campus Hero Defense!
defaultCaptions.facebook: Rescue classmates, secure classrooms and train a squad of teen superheroes to hold the Main Hall in Campus Hero Defense, a real-time strategy game you can play in your browser.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Campus Hero Defense: a browser RTS where student superheroes defend their high school from eight escalating invasion waves
defaultCaptions.discord: Can your hero squad survive all 8 waves, trigger a Spirit Surge and topple the Mecha-Mascot? Sign the Hall of Fame in Campus Hero Defense!
